description: Full-text search across 9M+ written US court opinions with field-level filtering. Returns opinion cluster summaries with case metadata, citations, matched text snippets, and the individual opinion variants filed in each case. Supports CourtListener field syntax (caseName:"roe v wade", court_id:scotus, judge:"Alito") and boolean operators (AND, OR, NOT). Use courtlistener_lookup_courts to find court IDs. CourtListener publishes free-tier limits of 5 req/min, 50/hr, 125/day; actual limits vary by token tier.

court.description: Filter to a specific court by court ID (e.g., "scotus", "ca9", "nyed"). Use courtlistener_lookup_courts to find court IDs.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's next_cursor field. Omit for the first page.

filed_after.description: Earliest filing date (ISO 8601, e.g., "2020-01-01"). Narrows search to opinions filed on or after this date.

filed_before.description: Latest filing date (ISO 8601). Narrows search to opinions filed before or on this date.

order_by.description: Result ordering. "score desc" (default) ranks by relevance. "citeCount desc" surfaces most-cited opinions first.

page_size.description: Number of results to request (default 20). CourtListener search enforces a minimum of 20 results per page regardless of the value passed — you will always receive at least 20 results. Each search costs one request against the rate limit.

q.description: Full-text query. Supports field syntax (caseName:"roe v wade", court_id:scotus, judge:"Alito") and boolean operators (AND, OR, NOT). Use plain English for semantic-style queries or legal citations.

status.description: Opinion publication status. "Published": precedential. "Unpublished": not citable as precedent in most jurisdictions. "Errata": corrections. "Separate": separate opinion filed outside main cluster. "In-chambers": single-justice order. "Relating-to": companion or related-case order. Omit to search all statuses.

name: courtlistener_search_opinions

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_query`: CourtListener rejects caller-authored query or filter syntax with a recognized diagnostic. `rate_limited`: 429 from CourtListener, or no request slot opened within the wait budget. `empty_query`: q is empty or whitespace-only after trimming — no request is sent. `invalid_date`: filed_after or filed_before is not a valid ISO 8601 calendar date. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

next_cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page; null when no more results.

notice.description: Recovery hint when results are empty — echoes filters and suggests how to broaden.

cite_count.description: Number of times this opinion has been cited by other opinions.

cluster_id.description: Opinion cluster ID — pass to courtlistener_get_opinion or courtlistener_get_citations.

court_id.description: Court identifier for use in subsequent filter parameters.

judges.description: Judge names associated with the opinion.

opinions.description: Opinion variants filed in this case (majority, concurrence, dissent, per curiam). Empty when upstream returned none.

items.description: One opinion variant within the cluster.

author_id.description: Person ID of the authoring judge — pass to courtlistener_get_judge; null when unattributed.

cites.description: Opinion IDs this variant cites. These are opinion-level IDs, not cluster IDs — courtlistener_get_opinion and courtlistener_get_citations both take a cluster_id, so do not pass these values to them directly.

download_url.description: URL of the originating court's copy; null when none was recorded. Often plain HTTP and prone to rot — prefer local_path.

id.description: Opinion ID for this variant — identifies one opinion within the cluster (the cluster itself is cluster_id).

local_path.description: CourtListener-hosted copy of the source document (https://storage.courtlistener.com/...); null if not stored.

per_curiam.description: True when the opinion was issued per curiam (by the court).

type.description: Variant type as an expanded label (e.g. "combined-opinion", "lead-opinion", "dissent").

snippet.description: Matched text excerpt, taken from the first entry in opinions[] that carries one; empty string when no variant has an excerpt. CourtListener does not mark which variant the search matched, so treat this as a relevance preview for the cluster, not as an excerpt attributable to a specific opinion — read opinions[] to attribute it.

totalCount.description: Total matching opinions in the corpus.

title: Search Court Opinions
